title: Refuse LAYER truecolor loss before AC1018
scope: Do not silently drop a nondefault LAYER RGB value when the target DXF revision omits group 420.

autodeskTruecolorBehavior.finding: Autodesk documents that AutoCAD 2004 and later use DXF group 420 for true color while group 62 carries ACI.

evidence.writerGate: writeLayer emits group 420 only when version > AC1015, so AC1018 is the first supported target that emits this RGB field.

implementation: writeLayer now refuses a nonnegative color24 at versions <= AC1015 before writing the LAYER record. The existing ACI compatibility projection remains unchanged.

verification.build: cmake --build build --target libdxfrw_dxf_fixture_tests -j4 passed with project warning-as-error settings.
verification.existingColorControl: libdxfrw_layer_dwg_cmc_roundtrip passes after its AC1015 case was updated to expect atomic refusal for truecolor-bearing input; AC1018/AC1032 still verify supported output and readback.
verification.profiles: ASCII and Binary AC1015 writes refuse a generated RGB_LAYER and preserve the pre-existing destination sentinel; same-writer AC1018 retry succeeds, and fresh typed readback checks color24 = 0x123456.

limits: Generated direct-writer refusal/retry and self-readback only.
Does not qualify producer prevalence, native color display, or layer graph closure.
